title: How to Build a Portfolio Website With AI (No Code Required)
summary: Build a professional portfolio website with AI in hours — not weeks. No coding, no templates. Includes project gallery, contact form, and CMS. Free to start.
body_markdown: Start with real case study text on each project page — Google indexes text, not screenshots. Use your name and specialty in page titles and meta descriptions. An About page with specific keywords matching what clients search for ("freelance UI designer New York") helps significantly. Two or three blog posts accelerate this further. Blink generates the SEO scaffolding automatically; you fill in the content. The[best AI app builders](https://blink.new/blog/best-ai-app-builders) all handle the technical SEO baseline — the content differentiation is up to you.
